trial_court: City Fast Track (Sessions) Judge, FTC-VI, Bangalore City
case_name: The State Of Karnataka vs Paramesh

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: The State Of Karnataka, Through J.C. Nagar Police Station

facts_of_case: Marriage of accused with N.V. Bharathi was performed on 1.11.2006. After marriage, accused made an attempt to commit murder of PW.5 - Nagaraj by assaulting with knife and caused grievous bleeding injuries. The jurisdictional Police registered a case in Crime No.228/2006 against the accused for the offence punishable under Section 324 of IPC.

legal_principles.principle: The finding recorded by the Family Court that the accused was suffering from mental disorder or mental illness is confirmed and binding on the criminal side.
legal_principles.held: this Court on the civil side and the same is binding on the criminal side.

legal_principles.principle: At the time of commission of crime, the accused was incapable of knowing the nature of the act by reason of unsoundness of mind and therefore, he is entitled to the benefit of Section 84 of IPC.
legal_principles.held: he is entitled to the benefit of Section 84 of IPC

outcome.final_order: The judgment and order of acquittal dated 20.09.2014 passed by the Presiding Officer, Fast Track Court-VI, Bangalore is set aside.

use_for_drafting: preparing prosecution case for murder trial
